snippet.title: Titanium Court Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You can play Titanium Court's demo NOW! Get ready for AP Thomson's latest game--a magical genre mashup that's full of surprises!

Play the demo and wishlist today! 
https://bit.ly/TC-Steam

Titanium Court is published by Fellow Traveller. Get updates on Titanium Court and other narrative games:

Discord: https://bit.ly/FellowTravellerDiscord
Bluesky: https://bit.ly/FellowTravellerBluesky
Email: https://bit.ly/FellowTravellerNewsletter
Fellow Traveller: https://bit.ly/FellowTravellerWebsite
